# Architecture & System Quality Checklist: Restaurant Reservation Platform

**Purpose**: Validate the completeness, clarity, consistency, and testability of architectural and system requirements across microservices boundaries before implementation.
**Created**: 2026-08-31
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## 1. Distributed Consistency & Event-Driven Requirements

- [x] CHK001 Are transactional outbox guarantees and polling/dispatch intervals explicitly specified for all publishing microservices? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK002 Are idempotency deduplication requirements and retention policies specified for all Kafka event consumer groups? [Coverage, Spec §FR-020, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK003 Is the failure recovery behavior specified for when Kafka broker connections are temporarily unavailable during outbox polling? [Edge Cases, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK004 Are trace context propagation requirements (`traceparent` header injection/extraction) documented across asynchronous Kafka message headers? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK005 Are Database-per-Service boundary constraints and cross-database access prohibitions explicitly documented for all 7 services? [Consistency, Plan §Project Structure]

## 2. Table Allocation & Domain State Machine Requirements

- [x] CHK006 Are tie-breaking rules unambiguously defined when multiple table combinations satisfy the requested party size? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK007 Are table overlap exclusion constraints quantified with specific timezone-aware timestamp interval definitions? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK008 Are all valid and invalid state transitions in the reservation lifecycle explicitly enumerated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK009 Are cancellation policy enforcement rules consistent between customer self-service actions and restaurant manager overrides? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK010 Is the fallback allocation behavior specified when a requested single table is out of service? [Edge Cases, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-005]

## 3. REST API Contracts & RFC 9457 Error Handling Requirements

- [x] CHK011 Are RFC 9457 Problem Details schemas specified with all required and optional attributes for every HTTP error status code? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018, Contract §openapi.yaml]
- [x] CHK012 Are pagination, filtering, and sorting parameter standards consistently specified across all collection endpoints? [Consistency, Contract §openapi.yaml]
- [x] CHK013 Is the HTTP response code and error payload format explicitly defined for concurrent reservation conflict race conditions? [Clarity, Spec §SC-002, Contract §openapi.yaml]
- [x] CHK014 Are request payload validation rules (e.g., party size > 0, future dates) specified for all mutative API operations? [Coverage, Contract §openapi.yaml]
- [x] CHK015 Are OpenAPI documentation generation requirements established for all public gateway endpoints and internal microservices? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019]

## 4. Security & Role-Based Access Control Requirements

- [x] CHK016 Are role-based permission boundaries (`CUSTOMER`, `RESTAURANT_MANAGER`, `ADMIN`) defined for every endpoint? [Coverage, Spec §FR-017]
- [x] CHK017 Is Keycloak OIDC JWT token validation and subject-to-customer mapping behavior unambiguously specified? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK018 Are tenant/ownership boundary requirements specified to prevent managers from modifying unassigned restaurants? [Edge Cases, Spec §FR-017]
- [x] CHK019 Are security requirements documented regarding the exclusion of sensitive credentials and tokens from log messages? [Security, Plan §Technical Context]

## 5. Observability, Telemetry & Resilience Requirements

- [x] CHK020 Are Spring Boot Actuator health probe policies (`/health/liveness` vs `/health/readiness`) explicitly defined for container environments? [Completeness, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK021 Are metric naming conventions and tags specified for custom business metrics (e.g., reservations, offers, cancellations)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK022 Are degradation and fallback requirements specified for when auxiliary services (Notification, Analytics) experience downtime? [Resilience, Spec §SC-007]
- [x] CHK023 Are distributed rate-limiting thresholds and Redis counter requirements quantified for the API Gateway? [Clarity, Plan §Technical Context]

## 6. Waiting List Fair FIFO & Offer Lifecycle Requirements

- [x] CHK024 Is the FIFO queue ordering criterion unambiguously defined by exact monotonic entry timestamp? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK025 Are offer expiration time windows and background cleanup schedule requirements explicitly quantified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK026 Is the cascade offer dispatch requirement specified when a customer rejects or allows an offer to expire? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK027 Is the idempotency requirement defined for scheduled reservation reminder jobs to prevent duplicate customer emails? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015]

## 7. Multi-Platform Build & Verification Requirements

- [x] CHK028 Are root Maven reactor build commands and submodule dependency constraints testable via `./mvnw clean verify`? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006, Plan §Constitution Check]
- [x] CHK029 Are Testcontainers configuration requirements documented for integration testing of PostgreSQL, Kafka, and Redis? [Completeness, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK030 Are Docker Compose multi-container initialization sequence and seed data requirements specified? [Completeness, Spec §SC-008, Quickstart §3]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after reviewer evaluation confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked (`[ ]`) when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
